statement: This file is a harness declaration of an owner decision, not evidence. It records that the owner authorized specific post-base changes to expected paths; it measures nothing about whether those changes are correct. Design v1.5 section 15.4 (line 564) states the expected-source-provenance predicate without an exception clause, so the mechanism below exists only because owner decision 134 directed it. Each listed path is lifted from EXPECTED_PATH_CHANGED_AFTER_BASE only while its recorded base state and current blob object id match the repository exactly; any further edit to a listed path restores the refusal.
